events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batch 3: 120 records were migrated, but 31 overseas customers have incorrect +1 phone prefixes. Batches 4–10 (280 records) have not been migrated and would have the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the past 24 hours; it is unknown whether they used affected numbers. Please provide the authoritative international phone numbers and a migration method that preserves country codes so the affected records can be corrected and migration resumed. Sales users should be alerted to verify phone numbers in the meantime.
